privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
TOTONOI THAI (hereinafter referred to as "the Management") establishes the following privacy policy (hereinafter referred to as "this Policy") regarding the handling of users' personal information.

1. Method of Collecting Personal Information
The Management may acquire the following information when a user uses the Service.
- Name, email address, phone number
- Credit card information necessary for payment (processed through payment processors such as Stripe. The Management does not retain your credit card number.)
- SNS account information such as LINE and Discord (during integration/authentication)
- Access information such as browsing history, IP address, and Cookies

2. Purpose of Using Personal Information
The purposes for which the Management collects and uses personal information are as follows:
- To provide and operate the Management's services
- To respond to user inquiries (including identity verification)
- To send necessary communications such as maintenance notices and important updates
- To identify users who violate the Terms of Service or attempt to use the service for fraudulent or improper purposes, and to refuse their use
- To allow users to view, change, or delete their registration information, and view their usage status

3. Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties
The Management will not provide personal information to third parties without the prior consent of the user, except in the following cases. However, this excludes cases permitted under the Personal Information Protection Law or other laws.
- When providing information to payment processing companies such as Stripe for payment processing
- When required by law
- When necessary to protect the life, body, or property of a person

4. Analytics Tools
This website uses Google Analytics, an access analysis tool by Google. Google Analytics uses Cookies to collect traffic data. This traffic data is collected anonymously and does not identify individuals. You can refuse collection by disabling Cookies. Please check your browser settings.

5. Changes to the Privacy Policy
1. The contents of this Policy may be changed without notifying the user, except for matters otherwise specified by laws and regulations or in this Policy.
2. The revised Privacy Policy shall take effect from the time it is posted on this website.

6. Contact for Inquiries
For inquiries regarding this Policy, please contact our official LINE or through the following email address.
Email: shunknomad@gmail.com
